text:
maria: Heads up — QA found noisy alerts after the SLO threshold rollout. Quick ping: are we moving to per-route threshold inheritance, or should the console display only per-tenant targets for now? The cards are showing conflicting numbers and it's generating notify fanout.
ben: Saw that. Can you paste repro steps?
maria: Open tenant `acme-corp` → Routes → `route-id-42`. Threshold card shows 99.9% but telemetry `slo.effective` is 99.0. Notify payloads are firing with 99.0 but console shows 99.9, so operators are confused.
rachel: That smells like a schema mismatch between console and notify API. Front-end started sending `effective_threshold` while the notify API still reads `target.pct`.
ben: We flipped the API last week during the rollout. Current sample payload we accept is:
```
{
  "target": 0.999,
  "quiet_window": 300
}
```
rachel: Right — so two pragmatic fixes: (A) have UI send both fields for backward compatibility, or (B) make API accept `effective_threshold` as an alias for `target.pct` and treat one as canonical.
liam: Option B is cleaner but needs a migration plan. Also we must consider quota/backoff: if migration causes slight diffs we'll spike notify fanout. We should avoid extra notifications during the switch.
maria: :point_up: Telemetry team — please confirm what fields dashboards are already keyed on. Our dashboards use `slo.target` and `slo.window` tags.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Schema v2 aliasing landed on staging. Integration tests 34/36 passed (failures are unrelated flaky auth tests).
ben: If we add aliasing, let's also add a console build-time lint that warns when both `target` and `effective_threshold` are present and they diverge. Also add a tiny in-UI banner during rollout.
rachel: UX suggestion for banner: "This route currently inherits SLOs from tenant defaults; local overrides may be ignored during rollout." Keep it dismissible.
liam: Also instrument a telemetry event `slo.override_attempt` with properties `{route_id, prev_target, attempted_target, user, rollout_age}` so we can monitor how often overrides cause noise.
maria: I'll draft the API PR (alias + migration note) and add the telemetry event. Can someone own the console lint + banner? @ben?
ben: I'll take console lint + banner — ETA EOD tomorrow.
rachel: I'll shepherd the API PR and add the alias behavior, plus add a migration flag behind a feature gate.
release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Noted — we'll include "SLO API: accepted `effective_threshold` as alias for `target.pct`" in next changelog.
maria: One more operational ask: can we gate noisy notify traffic during the first 24h after enabling aliasing? Propose soft rate-limit: if notify_rate(route) > 100/min and `rollout_age` < 24h then coalesce/de-dup.
liam: Router side can implement a soft throttle: track notify_rate(route) and if >100/min and rollout_age < 24h, switch to de-dupe mode for identical alerts for 10m windows.
ben: I'll add a client hint: console will start sending `rollout_start_ts` on requests so routing can be deterministic without guessing.
maria: Perfect. I'll update the rollout checklist and file the PR links here when ready. Thanks everyone — this should cut the noise and make the console/telemetry story coherent.
